title: unify sdks: auth/retries/streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, and version bumps (v1.146.1)
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Backport ergonomics and parity fixes across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs; unify auth+retry behavior for streaming APIs; bump SDK package versions to v1.146.1. No breaking changes for existing callers.
description: This PR unifies auth/retry semantics and streaming ergonomics across our Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and applies parity fixes discovered during integration testing. Motivation: customers were hitting inconsistent reconnect/retry behavior in streaming use-cases and small API ergonomics differences between SDKs that made cross-platform examples fragile. Changes: - Standardize token refresh hooks and retry/backoff across SDKs (refresh on 401, centralized jittered exponential backoff). - Stabilize streaming reconnect behavior: expose a single `StreamReconnectConfig`/equivalent, move to resumable-kv-cache-aware reconnects, and make default behavior conservative (max 2 automatic reconnects). - Improve ergonomics: clearer error types, consistent iterator/async iterator naming, and small convenience helpers for chunked responses. - Parity fixes: align TypeScript & Go response metadata with Python (response.headers, request_id propagation), fix edge case of empty final chunk handling. - Version bumps: python v1.146.1, typescript v1.146.1, go v1.146.1. NOTE: The description below contains the author checklist that was used during the rollout. Checklist: - [x] Update auth token refresh helper and central retry policy implementation - [x] Add integration tests for streaming reconnects (python/ts/go) - [x] Add unit tests for retry edge cases (circuit-breaker, 401 during body streaming) - [x] Update SDK CHANGELOGs and bump package versions - [x] Run cross-language quickstart smoke tests and examples - [x] Get approvals from runtime and SDK reviewers Related Linear tickets: ENG-1462 (streaming reconnect parity), ENG-1501 (sdk auth/retry ergonomics). Full description of changes and rationale is in the commits below.

review_comments: Jonah Kim: Can you confirm this does not change the default retry window for existing non-streaming calls? We need to avoid surprising customers.

Aisha Patel: Confirmed — core retry defaults for unary calls are unchanged. The centralization extracts the policy but uses the same default params for non-streaming paths. Added a unit test to assert default values.
Priya Singh: TS API rename looks good for parity, but calling out the breaking rename in the CHANGELOG is required.
Aisha Patel: Added explicit migration note in typescript/CHANGELOG.md and left a deprecated alias for one release.
Marcus Lee: Go integration test intermittently flaked in CI on arm runners — I added a short sleep and a retry in the test harness, plus a comment explaining the flake.
Jonah Kim: Approve after CI green.
ci_checks: windows/unit-tests: fail (flake on go integration) -> rerun -> pass
merge_outcome: Merged via squash by Jonah Kim after approvals and green CI. Commit message consolidated the feature+fix commits and included changelog entries. Backported the minimal test fix to release branch where needed.
notes: This change was coordinated with runtime to ensure retry semantics match server-side limits; rollout plan executed with canary on dedicated infra for one week. Observability: added streaming-specific metrics (stream.reconnects, stream.final_chunk_errors) and tagged them with sdk_lang=yes for cross-SDK dashboards.
